Hi Sanjay — welcome, and congrats on LaunchLab acceptance. Thanks for the attachments — quick read-through looked good.

Short answers up front: we do a limited set of accelerator top-ups for cohort teams on a case-by-case basis. Typical requirements are:
- cohort acceptance or proof-of-program membership
- short milestone plan tied to demo date (what you’ll show, expected token consumption)
- company stage check (we generally prioritize pre-revenue to <$5M ARR startups)

Requested from you (can reply inline):
- Confirm demo date and expected peak token usage (per two-hour demo plus prep runs)
- Are you using the hosted API (no infra changes) or planning a Dedicated trial?
- Any data residency/compliance needs?

Provisional offer: we can provision a $3,000 sandbox credit top-up immediately (no legal paperwork) to unblock demo prep, and then evaluate an additional $3,000 after we confirm cohort docs and usage plan. Final top-up requires a short MOU (I’ll route to Marissa for approval).

If that works, please send a 1‑page milestone plan and I’ll start the provisional credit flow.

Best,
Chloe Martin
